name: 8-Hour Workday
summary: 8-hour Workday is an anomaly search game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8. The player needs to explore a creepy, ominous office where dangerous anomalies are lurking around and try to make it through the work hours. There are 27 anomalies in the game. See if you can solve them all!

name: 8 Hours Till Dawn
summary:
8 Hours Till Dawn Started as a boardgame 15+ yeas ago and has now become a pixel art, friend-slop party, horror survival game, where you pre-program your survivor's movements and actions. Then watch your plans unfold in real-time usually into a chaotic mess. Can you survive the night in 8 Hours Till Dawn.
More survivors, weapons, maps, and a huge rogue-lite campaign mode that will utilize all the extra content planned on the road map.
Currently open playtesting 1-6 players, so invite your friends!
